feeds.title: Lens Culture
feeds.description: Lens Culture is one of the most comprehensive and far-reaching resources for discovering contemporary photography talent around the world. We believe that recognition and exposure are essential for photographers of all levels to move forward creatively and professionally, and this belief underpins our ongoing efforts to share, celebrate and reward great photography.

feeds.title: Elephant Magazine
feeds.description: Founded in 2009, Elephant.art is the definitive guide to contemporary art and visual culture. Elephant aims to survey the international contemporary art scene with more energy and depth than any other magazine in print or online.

feeds.title: Contemporary Art Daily
feeds.description: Selected contemporary art exhibitions from around the world, with new exhibitions posted each day.

feeds.title: Hi-Fructose Magazine
feeds.description: Hi-Fructose showcases an amalgamation of new contemporary, emerging as well distinguished artists, with a spotlight on awe-inspiring spectacles from around the world.

feeds.title: Velvet Eyes
feeds.description: Velvet Eyes is an independent publisher based in Paris, focused on contemporary photography and created to provide emerging artists an opportunity to share their work. By melting these photographs in a poetic narration, our goal is to reveal the sensuality hidden in blissful instants, appealing subjects, and suggestive landscapes.

feeds.title: The Jealous Curator Blog
feeds.description: The Jealous Curator launched in 2009, as a place for me to show artwork that 'made me jealous'. Yes, I was jealous of other artists' work, their lives, their success, their studios.
